verdict.rationale: Automatic image captioning is a fair extraction-quality question for a web scraper, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents image captioning, alt-text generation, or visual description. The pack mentions only markdown, structured JSON and screenshots, which are adjacent output formats and not captions a text-only model could reason over.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can get automatic captions for images on a page so a text-only model can reason about visual content
